title: Surgery versus intra-lesional sclerosis with polidocanol (Aetoxisclerol) in labial venous malformations in children and adults: a randomized controlled trial
official: Surgery versus intra-lesional sclerosis with polidocanol (Aetoxisclerol) in labial venous malformations in children and adults: a randomized controlled trial - SASOV
summary: Main objective: Evaluate the effectiveness of surgery on the overall outcome (including lesion volume regression, scar quality, and lip symmetry) of superficial veinous labial malformations compared to sclerotherapy at 12 months.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 4 years
2. Lower and/or upper labial symptomatic veinous malformation
3. Venous pocket with a surface area between 10 and 50 mm²
4. No history of surgery or interventional radiology on the area in the two years prior to inclusion
5. Accessible to sclerosis and surgery
6. Patient affiliated with a Social Security system
7. Informed written consent from the legal representatives of the child or participant if they are of legal age
Exclusion criteria:
1. Pregnant or breastfeeding women
2. Women of childbearing age without effective contraception throughout the study period
3. Patients under guardianship or curatorship, or under legal protection measures
4. Other vascular abnormalities
5. Contraindications to MRI
6. Contraindication to Aetoxisclerol®
7. Contraindication to general anesthesia
8. Contraindication to surgery
